description: baton: finish an elevation, and run baton's mod. In a plain claude session that ran `baton elevate`, stop claude cleanly once the turn ends so the shell relaunches the same conversation under baton. In a session baton hosts, the mod (baton.js) starts and steers the phase agents that work beside the lead, on baton's say-so; elsewhere it does nothing. Sessions hosted by baton get their other hooks from baton itself.
